author: kevp888
title: Freesound - 003A_091112_0826_SP_Resort_swimming_pool_before_dinner by kevp888
description:
Resort swimming-pool atmosphere before dinner. 
This recording has been made in a resort located in benalmadena Costa (Andalusia, Spain), at the end of a hot and sunny holiday afternoon. 
One can hear voices of adults and children enjoying their vacation, as well as sounds from the swimming-pool (water, splash) and from the terrace of the small restaurant located just near the pool. Some birds (sparrows, seagulls) can be heard in the background. 
Recorded in June 2025 with a Yamaha pocketrak c24. 
Fade in/out applied in Audacity. 
Please note that this audio file has been kindly recorded by Dominique LUCE, who is a photographer. If you’d like to discover his pictures, please visit http://dominiqueluce.wixsite.com/photographie
